""" def generate_post_html(author: str, title: str, body: str, post_tags: List[str]) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- author : str The name of the user who wrote the post. title : str Title of the post. body : str Main content of the post. safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") # Build tags HTML; each tag is wrapped in a safe_tags = [] for tag in post_tags: if tag: # ignore empty tags safe_tag = html.escape(tag, quote=True) safe_tags.append(f'{safe_tag}') tags_html = " ".join(safe_tags) # Format the final HTML html_output = USER_POST_FORMAT.format( title=safe_title, author=safe_author, body=safe_body, tags_html=tags_html ) return html_output.strip()
